items.title: McDonald's (MCD) Could Be 21% Above Fair Value Following Its Uber Expansion
items.summary: McDonald's (MCD) has expanded its alliance with Uber across 14 countries, making Uber the preferred delivery provider for orders in the McDonald's app and linking both companies' loyalty programs for shared rewards. The McDonald's share price has bounced sharply in the past month, with a 30‑day share price return of 19.95% and a 7‑day gain of 7.27%. items.title: What Is Uber Technologies (UBER) Gaining From Its Expanded 14 Market Delivery Tie Up?
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and McDonald’s agreed a multi-year expansion of their delivery and loyalty partnership across 14 global markets. Under the new agreement, Uber becomes the preferred integrated delivery provider for McDonald’s app orders in key international countries. The deal links Uber’s and McDonald’s loyalty programs, giving customers new cross-reward earning and redemption options.
